description: A disclosed-methodology comparison of countries to retire abroad in, scored on cost of living, visa route, healthcare and tax treatment.
tagline: Compare countries to retire abroad, based on data.
image_alt: Institute of Retirement — Compare countries to retire abroad.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our team of analysts breaks down visa requirements, healthcare systems, and cost of living metrics to help you compare retirement destinations.

editorial.how_we_test: We score countries using a disclosed methodology across four primary dimensions: cost of living index, visa route accessibility, healthcare quality and availability, and tax treatment for retirees. Every claim is verified against official government sources and updated annually.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We earn modest affiliate commissions and lead generation fees when you follow links to selected partners. We do not accept payment to alter a country's score.
editorial.corrections: If you find an inaccuracy in our visa or tax data, please contact us. We publish corrections on the affected page when official sources confirm a policy change.
